about: The mutant ledger of runtime/v1: edits of the runtime's source (runtime/v1 and the runtime/rt clock it parks on) that some runtime/v1 test must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./runtime/v1; the runner judges it by runtime/v1's own tests (docs/tooling.md, "Mutant ledger"). Seeded in batch 14 from the mutants batch 13 killed by hand (fua-b round 2 and its verifier, /home/exedev/.cache/baton/wf10/batch-13/verify/verdicts-2.md).

mutants.name: std1a-foreign-exit-range
mutants.rule: The Go entry still validates foreign Exit values even though Ergo's field is refined.

mutants.name: atomic-constructor
mutants.rule: NewInt64 holds its supplied value.

mutants.name: atomic-add-old-value
mutants.rule: Add returns the new value, not the replaced value.

mutants.name: atomic-swap-old
mutants.rule: Swap returns the replaced value.

mutants.name: atomic-cas-always
mutants.rule: A mismatching integer CAS does not store and returns false.

mutants.name: atomic-bool-cas-always
mutants.rule: A mismatching flag CAS does not store and returns false.

mutants.name: atomic-add-split
mutants.rule: Every increment has one linearization point: a split read/yield/store loses increments under tasks.Set. The broad anchor only introduces runtime.Gosched without a production test hook.

mutants.name: l10b-shrink-no-adjacent
mutants.rule: After the binary search, adjacent decrements reach a local minimum.

mutants.name: l10b-shrink-linear-search
mutants.rule: Monotone integer shrinking reaches the boundary with logarithmically bounded replay work.

mutants.name: l10b-shrink-no-fixpoint

mutants.rule: Changing a later component can unlock an earlier component; revisit to a fixpoint.

mutants.name: b13-stop-unparked
mutants.rule: runtime.md Machines and actors 11.16: a member's Stop of an actor waits parked, so a manual clock's Advance settles while it waits.

mutants.name: b13-drain-unparked
mutants.rule: runtime.md Machines and actors 11.16: a member's Drain of an actor waits parked.

mutants.rule: runtime.md Machines and actors 11.16: an Ask's or a State's wait for the answer is parked.

mutants.name: b13-exitof-unparked
mutants.from: func (a *Actor[S, E, D]) waitDone(t *rt.Task) { a.waitEnd(t, t.Done()) }
mutants.rule: runtime.md Machines and actors 11.16: ExitOf's wait for the actor's end is parked.

mutants.name: b13-send-unparked
mutants.from:

			p = rt.Park(t, s, stop, nil)
mutants.to:

			p = rt.Park(t, s, stop, nil)
mutants.rule: runtime.md Machines and actors 11.16: a Send's wait for room in a full mailbox is parked.

mutants.name: b13-advancing-check-removed
mutants.rule: runtime.md 16: one Advance of a clock runs at a time; a second is a defect in its caller, not a wait.

mutants.name: b14-settle-hostget
mutants.rule: stdlib.md actor 7 Hosts, runtime.md 11.16: a Host.Get waiting on an empty host is parked.

mutants.name: b14-settle-nested-advance
mutants.rule: runtime.md 11.16: a task's Wait for another task is parked, so the task it waits for may Advance the clock.

mutants.name: cu7-newline-position
mutants.rule: The error location is the invalid newline's line, not the following line.

mutants.name: cu7-duplicate-key
mutants.rule: TOML rejects a key defined twice.

mutants.name: cu7-first-array-table
mutants.rule: A nested header belongs to the most recent array-table element.

mutants.name: cu7-underscore-anywhere
mutants.rule: Underscores separate digits and cannot occur at numeric token edges.

mutants.name: cu7-multiline-quotes
mutants.rule: Four/five closing quotes keep one/two quote characters in the value.

mutants.name: cu7-error-location
mutants.from: p.err = TOMLMalformed{Line: p.line, Key: p.key, Reason: why}
mutants.rule: A malformed config reports its 1-based source line and dotted key.

mutants.name: root-reopens-directory

mutants.rule: A Root retains the opened directory across a rename and replacement of its name.

mutants.name: root-release-omitted
mutants.rule: Every acquired Root closes at frame end, including failure, defect and stop.

mutants.name: cu2-reader-loses-buffered-tail
mutants.rule: The one stdin buffer keeps the bytes after a taken item for the next read, of any kind.

mutants.name: gapos-getwd-raw-error
mutants.rule: Every failure of the host's Getwd is os.NoWorkdir, so the Ergo row holds it whole.

mutants.name: x7-late-output
mutants.from: tagged := env.kind == timerSignal || env.kind == workSignal || env.kind == childSignal
mutants.rule: NoLateChildOutput: a child output of an ended entry is dropped, never stepped.

mutants.name: x7-parent-first
mutants.rule: ChildrenStopFirst, ChildInsideEntry: an entry's exit waits for each child's end before it stops the next one and before the next entry opens.

mutants.name: x7-by-kind
mutants.rule: ChildInsideEntry: an entry keeps every child it started, so its exit stops them all.

mutants.name: x7-unshielded-work
mutants.rule: ChildInsideEntry: a Stop reaches an entry's work only after the entry's children ended.

mutants.name: x7-epoch-wraps
mutants.rule: NoLateChildOutput: entries are compared whole; a counter that wraps at 4 steps an output four entries late.

mutants.name: x7-adopt-unseen
mutants.rule: An explored run sees every wait: an entry's exit waits for a child's start in progress through the scheduler, not on kidsMu with the baton held. Without it the run hangs with the baton held until the test's hung-test deadline.

mutants.name: x7-law-drops-child-output
mutants.rule: The reader counts every child output the parent steps; one that drops them never sees NoLateChildOutput break.

mutants.name: x7-law-open-unchecked
mutants.from: l.breaks("ChildInsideEntry", a.name+" opened entry "+uintText(epoch)+" while "+k.name+" lives")
mutants.rule: ChildInsideEntry: the next entry opens only after the old entry's children ended.

mutants.name: x7-law-work-unchecked
mutants.from:
if k := l.liveKid(en); k != nil {
				l.breaks("ChildInsideEntry", "the work
mutants.to:
if k := l.liveKid(en); false && k != nil {
				l.breaks("ChildInsideEntry", "the work
mutants.rule: ChildInsideEntry: an entry's work is stopped only after the entry's children ended.

mutants.name: x7-law-start-unchecked
mutants.rule: ChildInsideEntry: a child starts only while the entry that starts it is open.

mutants.name: x7-law-sibling-unchecked
mutants.rule: ChildrenStopFirst: the last started child stops first.

mutants.name: x7-law-orphan-unchecked
mutants.rule: ChildrenStopFirst: no child lives after its parent ended.

mutants.name: x7-law-owner-lost
mutants.rule: A child is found from the task tree: the nearest ancestor that is a work names its entry.

mutants.name: x8-name-unregistered
mutants.rule: queue.New names its queue in an explored run.

mutants.name: x8-name-any-frame
mutants.rule: A handle's name is the nearest frame at a position of the program's source, not a runtime frame.

mutants.name: x8-name-first-call
mutants.rule: Among the calls on the frame's line, the name is the constructor's call, with its column.

mutants.name: x8-name-base-only
mutants.rule: The file is named relative to the folder of the program's files (its package path), not by its base name.

mutants.name: x8-names-not-sent
mutants.rule: A worker's outcome carries the run's handle names to the search.

mutants.name: x8-set-spawning-unseen
mutants.rule: In an explored run a Set member's end waits for the owner's spawn through the scheduler, not on the Set's lock with the baton held (else the run hangs).

mutants.name: mk1-waitkids-unparked
mutants.origin: wf10/MK1 round 1 (the downloads manager's deadlock, wf10 F8 known gap 1)
mutants.from:
if wt.InDomain() {
		p = rt.Park(wt, r.done, nil, func() bool { return isDone(r.done) })
mutants.to:
if false {
		p = rt.Park(wt, r.done, nil, func() bool { return isDone(r.done) })
mutants.rule: runtime.md 11.16 and 13: a work that started children waits for their stop parked, so a manual clock's Advance fires the timer whose signal stops them.

mutants.name: mk1-halt-unparked
mutants.origin: wf10/MK1 round 1 (inventory of runtime/v1's raw waits)
mutants.rule: runtime.md 11.16 and 13: an entry's stop of a child waits for the child's end parked, so a child whose release sleeps on the clock ends under Advance.

mutants.name: mk1-stopkids-wakes-unparked
mutants.rule: rt idle.go: a waker clears the parked flag of the wait it ends before the event is visible; a work's waitKids left parked after its children stopped keeps the clock's domain settled while the work runs.

mutants.name: dh1-unbound-closed
mutants.rule: runtime.md Machines and actors 17: a host a durable recover makes is unbound, not closed, so the recovered actor's first entry can bind it.

mutants.name: dh1-late-host-kept
mutants.rule: runtime.md Machines and actors 17: a host made after the recover returned (by a task it started) is closed at once; no entry will bind it.

mutants.name: dh1-first-entry-binds-none
mutants.rule: runtime.md Machines and actors 17: the recovered actor's first entry binds each recovered host its first state holds.

mutants.name: dh1-rest-kept
mutants.rule: runtime.md Machines and actors 17: a recovered host the first state does not hold (only an earlier state of the replay held it) is closed.

mutants.name: dh1-all-held
mutants.rule: runtime.md Machines and actors 17: the first entry binds only the recovered hosts its state holds; the others close.

mutants.name: dh1-renew-unbound
mutants.rule: runtime.md Machines and actors 17 and 18: a supervised restart's recover makes unbound hosts, as the first start's does.

mutants.name: dh1-recover-hosts-kept
mutants.rule: runtime.md Machines and actors 17: every host a failed recover made is closed, and so is every host no entry took when the start returns.

mutants.name: dh1-no-actor-kept
mutants.rule: runtime.md Machines and actors 17: a recovered host that no entry binds is closed when the start returns.

mutants.name: dh1-first-publish-early
mutants.rule: runtime.md Machines and actors 16.4: the first entry with recovered hosts and a work is shown once the work filled them, waited or ended.

mutants.name: bs2-status-line
mutants.rule: runtime.md Exit causes, os.Exit rule 2: the line of a code outside 1..125 names the code.

mutants.name: bs2-report-failure-text
mutants.rule: runtime.md Exit causes (binsize BS2): a failure's line is fmt's %v of it, so a nil error or one whose Error panics is written, not raised.

mutants.name: bs2-host-text-user-missing
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Types 4 (binsize BS2): a program that names a body reaching rt.TypedText imports the gofmt leaf.

mutants.name: bs3-instant-unit
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Types 4 (binsize BS3): a manual or virtual clock's rt.Instant is nanoseconds since the Unix epoch; time.Manual reads it as that time.

mutants.name: bs6-trim-off
mutants.rule: binsize BS6: trimmed Go frames match module-relative source names.

mutants.name: bs6-site-wide
mutants.from:
Func, Callee, File uint32
	Line, Column       uint32
mutants.to:
Func, Callee, File uint32
	Line, Column       uint32
	unused [8]byte
mutants.rule: binsize BS6: a call site uses at most 24 bytes.

mutants.name: bs6-decode-file
mutants.rule: binsize BS6: the report decodes each compact site's file index, not its function index.

mutants.name: bs6-wide-file
mutants.rule: binsize BS6: registering the selectable wide reference preserves its file names when normalizing the source map.

mutants.name: bs7-graph-ignored
mutants.rule: binsize BS7: a traced actor names its arms from the graph its start received.

mutants.name: bs7-timer-lookup
mutants.rule: binsize BS7: a timer's signal is the one the graph gives the state its entry opened in.

mutants.name: bs7-hidden-graph
mutants.rule: binsize BS7: GraphOf is a hidden parameter that the lowering supplies.
mutants.gap: killed only by lower:TestGraphLoweringsTraceAlike (the hidden GraphOf parameter is read when a program is lowered), which runtime/v1's scope does not run (scripts/mutants judges a package's ledger by its own tests); run by hand: apply the edit, go test -run TestGraphLoweringsTraceAlike ./internal/sketch/lower fails with "the std function start has 14 Go parameters for 13 arguments" (EXPLORE-rt r3).

mutants.name: bs7b-arm-once
mutants.rule: binsize BS7b: the patterns of one case are one arm, so a decision names its site once.

mutants.name: bs8-host-walk-user-missing
mutants.rule: binsize BS8: every exported body that makes an actor's host links the hostwalk leaf, which walks a recovered state for hosts.

mutants.name: bs8-walk-unset
mutants.rule: binsize BS8: the hostwalk leaf's init installs the walk that finds a recovered state's hosts.

mutants.name: ert-explored-root-unguarded
mutants.from:
_, err := guarded(t, func(t *rt.Task) (struct{}, error) { return struct{}{}, body(t) })
		return err
mutants.rule: An explored run's root classifies its own defect, with the context in force, as a live root does.

mutants.name: ert-explored-main-drops-exit
mutants.rule: An explored main exits with its root's exit: status and report as in a live run.

mutants.name: ert-domain-push-ignores-stop
mutants.rule: A Push parked in a clock's domain (every task of an explored run) wakes on its task's stop (gap 1).

mutants.name: ert-await-never-ready
mutants.rule: A task waiting through the scheduler (rt.Await) runs again once its event came.
